_comment: Copy to runtime.json and set apiBase to your deployed API (e.g. https://your-test-host.example/api). Same-origin static hosting can use /api if the API is reverse-proxied behind the same host. The browser loads GET {apiBase}/public/site-config for placeholders (all data-ph copy/links), social feeds, live ticker, video iframes (data-ncc-video slots), home featured list, livestream archive, sermon notes, and optional calendar XML URL. Edit everything in Staff admin → Site configuration.
